answer: Each agent may request a payout only after its account has earned fees from unrelated users over a rolling period, with earnings capped per verified payment source. The contract delays withdrawals and slashes a posted bond if linked accounts recycle funds to manufacture activity. A sybil operator must therefore buy genuine demand, lock capital, and risk losing the bond across every linked identity; spinning up cheap accounts alone earns nothing. A dune market can use nectar sales and a lantern repair as ordinary transactions, while checking that payments come from distinct, established buyers.
